title: Master Munda Source Census
description: Federated discovery census. Existing canonical source records remain in the master source register; corpus-specific records remain in their evidence-preserving source bundles; standalone bibliographic discoveries are recorded separately. Reader-facing web-discovery leads are maintained as a separate discovery layer and are not added to the audited source-identity total until deterministic deduplication/canonicalization is complete.

source_registers.counting_rule: Count volume slots with a verified external locator that are not already represented in the canonical master source register.

source_registers.id_policy: new standalone discoveries receive immutable SRC-MMSC identifiers after duplicate checking

source_registers.counting_rule: Discovery leads are searchable but excluded from the audited source-identity total until canonical deduplication confirms whether a lead is a new source, an alternate locator, a catalogue wrapper, or a duplicate. WEB-MUN-0078 has been canonicalized as SRC-MMSC-000002 and is therefore counted once through the standalone register, never double-counted here.

metrics.note: Audited source-identity count is repository-derived: 14 preserved canonical master-source records + 12 verified external Mundarica volume locators (II-XIII) + 2 standalone MMSC identities = 28. Eighty-one reader-facing web-discovery leads are tracked separately; exactly one (WEB-MUN-0078) has been deterministically canonicalized as SRC-MMSC-000002 and is counted once through the standalone source register. These metrics are not a claim that all Munda/Mundari sources have been discovered. Public, catalogue, index, dataset or media availability is never interpreted as unrestricted reuse permission.

latest_discovery.title: Gender Relations and Witches among the Indigenous Communities of Jharkhand, India

provenance.caution: Article identity and abstract-level Munda/Ho relevance are verified. Sensitive gender/witchcraft propositions are not promoted without full-text passage, method, participant context, corroboration and community-aware review.

web_discovery_layer.boundary: Searchable discovery metadata only unless a lead is explicitly canonicalized and separately linked to evidence. One lead is currently canonicalized; the remaining leads are not included in audited source-identity totals.
